source: Preregistered new TRAIN-only policy family: adverse crossing of causal volume-profile POC
virtual_mode: FOLLOW only; other paths remain HOLD
expected_direction: Positive paired PnL change versus FOLLOW HOLD on each side
definition: When profitable, exit BUY on a consecutive-snapshot crossing of 60m POC from above to at/below it; exit SELL on a crossing from below to at/above it.

thresholds.crossing: signed_distance_price_to_POC crosses zero against virtual side

missing_policy: A missing current or prior POC distance does not trigger.
baseline: Unchanged FOLLOW HOLD; compare FOLLOW and INVERT always baselines.
failure_criteria: Use all six gates in INTRATRADE_R3_PROTOCOL.md
execution: First quote strictly after arrival plus latency; TP=240, SL=180, TIME_EXIT=100 take precedence.
causality: Only causal current and previous snapshot feature values; no targets as features.
